title: Topic 6: Home & Where You Live - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Name rooms and furniture; describe your home simply

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Describe your home.
Say 4 things:
1. House big or small? (My house / apartment is...)
2. The rooms (There are ... bedrooms / There is a...)
3. ONE thing and where it is (There is a table in the...)
4. One family sentence (T3): My mother is in the kitchen...
Example: My house is small. There are two bedrooms.
There is a big table in the kitchen. My brother is in
his bedroom!

Tip: Walk around your home (in your head!) room by room.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic06_home.txt, Lesson 6.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: Describes home with to be + adjective
There is / there are used correctly
